claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Novelty claim: no prior work in the reviewed literature simultaneously combines (i) learned multimodal EO fusion into (ii) explicit calibrated probabilistic crop-water-state estimation with (iii) optimised irrigation decision support under that uncertainty end-to-end; genuine probabilistic precedents (Bayesian maximum entropy, copula-based drought-to-irrigation, dynamic Bayesian networks, MF-FusionNet) each lack at least one of the three elements
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/concept_note.md (systematic literature review and research-gap matrix); inference chain: concept_note.md establishes the gap matrix by reviewing prior work across two gradients; the novelty claim derives from the finding that the combination-cell is empty in the reviewed corpus — a synthesis, not a direct quotation from a single source

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Structural integrity flag: the section's validation_status.claim_statuses[] array contains non-globally-unique claim_ids. Claim_ids C01 through C25 each appear twice — once in claims from sub_sections 1.1/1.2 and once in claims from sub_sections 1.3/1.4. Each duplicate claim carries distinct content and a distinct source_ref, so content traceability is preserved at the individual entry level. However, claim-level reference by ID is ambiguous. This is a bookkeeping defect in the claim tracking mechanism, not an unattributed project-fact claim.
claim_audit_results.source_ref: Structural observation from reading validation_status.claim_statuses[]; no Tier 1-4 source required to validate this structural finding
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Non-globally-unique claim_ids in validation_status.claim_statuses[]: duplicate entries for C01-C25 across sub-section boundaries. Each duplicated entry has a source_ref, so no constitutional halt is warranted (§10.5, §12.2 are not violated). Recommend globally unique claim_id scheme in future drafts.
